Research to Slides

Turn a research folder into a teaching slide deck.

What it does

Converts a Deep Research topic folder or KB modules into a PowerPoint deck built for learning - assertion-style titles, one idea per slide, and cognitive-load limits applied automatically.

When to use it

You want to study a research topic as slides, or build training material to teach the team from existing KB modules.

How to trigger it

"turn this into slides"

"make a presentation from my research"

"convert my modules to a deck"
